Courses and term archive

/app/courses
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S02

Find current and prior teaching or learning contexts by term. Archive availability follows enrollment, access and institution retention policy rather than promising permanent history.

Stay on coursesOpen archive
Permissions
  • Each card is filtered by active or retained membership.
  • Archived student access includes only their retained work and released feedback.
  • Staff role expiry can remove historical staff access even when student enrollment remains.
Responsive
  • Cards become a single list; filters wrap rather than require horizontal scrolling.
  • Preserve selected year/term after returning from a course.
Accessibility
  • Current/Past are links or buttons with announced selection, not unlabeled decorative tabs.
  • Read-only and unavailable use text alongside icons; course names remain complete.
Data
  • Course membership summary, institution term catalog, retention/access status.
  • Next-work summaries only for authorized current contexts.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Selecting Fall 2025 cannot reveal another user's retained submissions.
  • Archive course opens read-only and blocks stale submission actions.
  • A term lookup error shows retry rather than 'you have no courses'.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
